';p.alt='Mo';p.classList.add('mo')}
else{p.src='data:image/webp;base64,';p.alt='Mo';p.classList.add('mo')}}
function actions(list){let a=$('actions');a.replaceChildren();a.className=list.length===3?'three':list.length===2?'two':'';list.forEach(([label,fn,cls])=>{let b=document.createElement('button');b.className='btn'+(cls?' '+cls:'');b.textContent=label;b.onclick=()=>{if(g.paused||g.modal)return;beep();fn()};a.appendChild(b)})}
function phase(p){g.phase=p;$('sceneTitle').textContent=({intro:'THE ULTIMATE COVER-UP',cleanup:'FIND IT. SPRAY IT. HIDE IT.',cleanupResult:'THE CLEANUP REPORT',question:'UTW INCIDENT CONTROL',answer:'UTW INCIDENT CONTROL',panic:'NOOSH’S LAST QUESTION',end:'THE FINAL VERDICT'})[p]||'THE ULTIMATE COVER-UP';scene.className=p==='cleanup'?'cleaning':p==='question'||p==='panic'?'interrogation':p==='end'?'endphase':'';$('evidenceLayer').classList.toggle('hidden',p!=='cleanup');$('destinationLayer').classList.toggle('hidden',p!=='cleanup');$('stainsLayer').classList.toggle('hidden',p!=='cleanup');$('secret').classList.toggle('hidden',p!=='cleanup'||g.secret);$('speech').classList.toggle('hidden',p==='cleanup');hud()}
function introRender(){phase('intro');const [name,line]=intro[g.line];story(name,line,'THE GREAT PALACE CLEANUP • '+(g.line+1)+' / '+intro.length);actions([[g.line===intro.length-1?'START CLEANING ▸':'NEXT ▸',()=>{if(g.line<intro.length-1){g.line++;introRender()}else beginCleanup()},'gold']])}
function objectSVG(type){if(type==='ticket')return '<svg viewBox="0 0 60 42" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 5 Q12 9 14 1 H56 V14 Q47 21 56 28 V39 H13 Q12 31 4 34Z" fill="#d7b06a" stroke="#633529" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M18 9H48M18 18H44M18 27H50" stroke="#7d4435" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M32 6V35" stroke="#a47539" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="3 2"/></svg>';
if(type==='cap')return '<svg viewBox="0 0 50 55" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M13 13H37L35 45Q25 51 15 45Z" fill="#7c3d39" stroke="#f3be81" stroke-width="3"/><rect x="10" y="8" width="30" height="14" rx="3" fill="#d09a71" stroke="#55364c" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M14 11V20M20 11V20M26 11V20M33 11V20" stroke="#603d33" stroke-width="2"/></svg>';
if(type==='crown')return '<svg viewBox="0 0 60 52" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 17L16 28 24 6 32 28 47 13 54 29 50 45H12Z" fill="#f8c960" stroke="#693d4b" stroke-width="4"/><circle cx="24" cy="6" r="4" fill="#b64d96"/><circle cx="47" cy="13" r="4" fill="#d960a8"/><rect x="12" y="40" width="39" height="8" rx="2" fill="#d99a48"/></svg>';
return '<svg viewBox="0 0 55 62" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8 6L44 9 47 55 6 53Z" fill="#ead6ac" stroke="#745047" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M14 17H40M13 26H36M13 35H41M14 43H35" stroke="#86544b" stroke-width="2"/><text x="23" y="18" font-size="7" fill="#9d4d47">VOLVO</text></svg>'}
function hotspotArt(id){
 const path=id==='rug'?'<path d="M105 4 L890 4 L996 118 L5 118 Z"/>':id==='book'?'<path d="M15 5L240 5L240 292L15 292Z"/>':id==='box'?'<path d="M20 14L199 9L232 42L229 171L15 178Z"/>':'<path d="M23 13Q114 -10 207 13L177 212Q110 236 50 212Z"/>';
 const vb=id==='rug'?'0 0 1000 125':id==='book'?'0 0 260 300':id==='box'?'0 0 250 190':'0 0 230 230';
 return '<svg class="hotspotTrace" viewBox="'+vb+'" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true">'+path+'</svg>'
}
function beginCleanup(){
 phase('cleanup');$('tiny').style.display='';$('partner').style.display='none';$('speech').classList.add('hidden');
 $('sceneTitle').textContent='THE VERY SUSPICIOUS CLEANUP';g.seconds=175;g.found=0;g.washed=0;g.clues=[];g.stains=[];g.secret=false;g.end=null;g.timeOver=false;g.selectedClue=null;
 $('secret').classList.remove('hidden');$('secret').classList.remove('revealed');$('evidenceLayer').replaceChildren();$('stainsLayer').replaceChildren();$('destinationLayer').replaceChildren();$('roomDecor').replaceChildren();
 $('heading').textContent='Hide the evidence';$('story').textContent='Find evidence and tap the glowing furniture to hide it. SPRAY then finger-WIPE the armrest and jam; MOP the muddy raccoon trail.';$('kicker').textContent='NOOSH RETURNS SOON • USE YOUR FINGERS';
 $('roomDecor').innerHTML="<div class=\"room-bin\"><img src=\"data:image/webp;base64,\" alt=\"\" /></div><div id=\"seatTracks\" aria-hidden=\"true\"><svg viewBox=\"0 0 260 65\" preserveAspectRatio=\"none\"><defs><filter id=\"mudGrain\"><feTurbulence type=\"fractalNoise\" baseFrequency=\".18\" numOctaves=\"3\" seed=\"8\" result=\"noise\"/><feDisplacementMap in=\"SourceGraphic\" in2=\"noise\" scale=\"2\"/></filter></defs><g fill=\"#5b331f\" stroke=\"#d6a66d\" stroke-opacity=\".4\" stroke-width=\"2\" opacity=\".93\" filter=\"url(#mudGrain)\"><g transform=\"translate(63 29) rotate(-12)\"><ellipse cy=\"9\" rx=\"18\" ry=\"9\"/><ellipse cx=\"-16\" cy=\"-6\" rx=\"5.5\" ry=\"8\"/><ellipse cx=\"-5\" cy=\"-12\" rx=\"6.5\" ry=\"8\"/><ellipse cx=\"7\" cy=\"-11\" rx=\"6.5\" ry=\"8\"/><ellipse cx=\"18\" cy=\"-5\" rx=\"5.5\" ry=\"7\"/></g><g transform=\"translate(168 32) rotate(23)\"><ellipse cy=\"9\" rx=\"19\" ry=\"10\"/><ellipse cx=\"-16\" cy=\"-6\" rx=\"6\" ry=\"8\"/><ellipse cx=\"-5\" cy=\"-12\" rx=\"7\" ry=\"9\"/><ellipse cx=\"7\" cy=\"-11\" rx=\"7\" ry=\"8\"/><ellipse cx=\"18\" cy=\"-5\" rx=\"6\" ry=\"8\"/></g></g><path d=\"M30 47C63 36 93 64 126 42S195 58 221 37\" stroke=\"#664122\" stroke-width=\"11\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" opacity=\".34\" fill=\"none\"/></svg></div>";
 destinations.forEach(dest=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='stash';b.dataset.dest=dest.id;b.style.left=dest.x+'%';b.style.top=dest.y+'%';b.setAttribute('aria-label',dest.hint);b.innerHTML=hotspotArt(dest.id)+'<span class="stashLabel">'+(dest.id==='rug'?'UNDER THE RUG':dest.id==='book'?'BOOKSHELF':dest.id==='bin'?'TRASH BIN':'STORAGE CRATE')+'</span>';b.addEventListener('click',()=>stashSelected(dest.id));$('destinationLayer').appendChild(b)});
 items.forEach((item,i)=>{const pt=item.spots[Math.floor(Math.random()*item.spots.length)];const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='clue';b.setAttribute('aria-label','Select '+item.name);b.dataset.i=String(i);b.style.left=pt[0]+'%';b.style.top=pt[1]+'%';b.style.setProperty('--rot',[-14,11,-6,17][i]+'deg');b.innerHTML=objectSVG(item.type)+'<span class="mark">🔍</span>';b.addEventListener('click',()=>findClue(i,b));$('evidenceLayer').appendChild(b);$('tr'+i).textContent=item.emoji+' '+item.short;$('tr'+i).classList.remove('done','selected')});
 dirt.forEach((item,i)=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='stain '+item.style;b.dataset.i=String(i);b.style.left=item.pos[0]+'%';b.style.top=item.pos[1]+'%';b.style.setProperty('--spin',[15,-20,30][i]+'deg');b.style.setProperty('--scrub',0);
 b.innerHTML='<span class="dirt">'+(item.style==='pawprints'?pawSVG():item.style==='wetarm'?wetSVG():glitterSVG())+'</span><span class="scrubMeter"><i></i></span>';b.setAttribute('aria-label','Clean '+item.name);b.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>stainDown(e,i,b));b.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>stainMove(e,i,b));b.addEventListener('pointerup',()=>stopScrub());b.addEventListener('pointercancel',()=>stopScrub());$('stainsLayer').appendChild(b);g.stains.push({wet:false,progress:0,done:false})});
 mode='find';cleanupActions();hud();clearInterval(tick);tick=setInterval(cleanupTick,100);
}
function pawSVG(){
 let s='<svg viewBox="0 0 500 135" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true"><defs><filter id="pawRough"><feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency=".1" numOctaves="2" seed="5" result="n"/><feDisplacementMap in="SourceGraphic" in2="n" scale="2"/></filter></defs><path d="M18 106Q103 89 165 108T321 98T487 106" stroke="#714829" opacity=".25" stroke-width="15" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M58 113Q120 84 199 112T333 105T482 107" stroke="#47271c" opacity=".22" stroke-width="8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><g fill="#67432a" stroke="#95633e" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-opacity=".32" filter="url(#pawRough)" opacity=".87">';
 [[63,74,-23,1],[145,46,20,.82],[245,77,-15,1.1],[346,49,22,.95],[438,76,-15,1.05]].forEach(([x,y,rot,scale])=>{
 s+='<g transform="translate('+x+' '+y+') rotate('+rot+') scale('+scale+')"><path d="M-21 14Q-20 -5 -4 0Q0 4 5 0Q23 -8 23 13Q21 27 0 28Q-19 26 -21 14Z"/><ellipse cx="-20" cy="-14" rx="8" ry="11"/><ellipse cx="-6" cy="-23" rx="8" ry="12"/><ellipse cx="10" cy="-22" rx="8" ry="12"/><ellipse cx="23" cy="-12" rx="8" ry="11"/></g>'});
 return s+'</g><g fill="#633d21" opacity=".75"><circle cx="35" cy="114" r="6"/><circle cx="174" cy="118" r="5"/><circle cx="291" cy="119" r="8"/><circle cx="392" cy="122" r="6"/></g></svg>';
}
function wetSVG(){return '<svg viewBox="0 0 155 105" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true"><defs><linearGradient id="sticky" x1="0" y1="0" x2=".1" y2="1"><stop stop-color="#fff1d3"/><stop offset=".38" stop-color="#f2b1b9"/><stop offset=".75" stop-color="#a94a6a"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#6d2547"/></linearGradient></defs><path d="M10 16Q33 -6 72 8Q111 -3 143 25Q151 37 136 43Q123 46 123 61Q123 84 109 91Q93 92 96 75Q96 51 83 46Q73 42 73 62Q77 105 56 101Q40 98 43 80L42 47Q26 61 19 41Q7 37 10 16Z" fill="url(#sticky)" stroke="#fbe3ce" stroke-opacity=".65" stroke-width="2.8"/><path d="M30 18Q63 12 80 22M98 23L112 35M57 53L58 77" stroke="#fff5eb" stroke-opacity=".9" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>'}
function glitterSVG(){return '<svg viewBox="0 0 290 115" aria-hidden="true"><defs><linearGradient id="jam" x1="0" x2="1" y1="0" y2="1"><stop stop-color="#54251e"/><stop offset=".5" stop-color="#ad5747"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#361d28"/></linearGradient></defs><path d="M5 61C31 32 54 52 79 40S133 36 164 48S241 42 287 66L271 87Q204 70 167 88T83 78Q40 102 5 75Z" fill="url(#jam)" opacity=".84"/><path d="M34 62Q105 36 156 62T266 69" fill="none" stroke="#f2a4a9" opacity=".65" stroke-width="6"/>' + [[28,28,'#efda4d'],[54,84,'#fd64a0'],[90,18,'#f4cd61'],[124,69,'#25cfde'],[155,28,'#fcaf57'],[197,95,'#dc70d5'],[230,36,'#60d7e6'],[270,83,'#ffee78']].map(([x,y,c])=>'<path d="M'+x+' '+(y-7)+'L'+(x+3)+' '+(y-2)+'L'+(x+9)+' '+y+'L'+(x+3)+' '+(y+3)+'L'+x+' '+(y+9)+'L'+(x-3)+' '+(y+3)+'L'+(x-9)+' '+y+'L'+(x-3)+' '+(y-2)+'Z" fill="'+c+'" stroke="#42253a" stroke-width="1.3"/>').join('')+'</svg>'}
function findClue(i,b){if(g.phase!=='cleanup'||g.paused||g.modal||g.clues.includes(i))return;
 g.selectedClue=i;mode='find';scene.classList.add('placing');cleanupActions();$('evidenceLayer').querySelectorAll('.clue').forEach(e=>e.classList.toggle('selected',e===b));
 items.forEach((_,j)=>$('tr'+j).classList.toggle('selected',j===i));
 $('destinationLayer').querySelectorAll('.stash').forEach(e=>e.classList.toggle('active',e.dataset.dest===items[i].target));
 $('heading').textContent='Selected: '+items[i].short;
 $('story').textContent='Now tap the highlighted '+destinations.find(d=>d.id===items[i].target).name+' to hide the '+items[i].short.toLowerCase()+'.';beep(520,.06);
}
function stashSelected(id){if(g.phase!=='cleanup'||g.paused||g.modal)return;if(g.selectedClue===null){toast('Pick up a suspicious item FIRST!');return}
 const i=g.selectedClue,item=items[i];if(item.target!==id){toast('Not there! Try the highlighted '+destinations.find(d=>d.id===item.target).name+'.');return}
 const clue=$('evidenceLayer').querySelector('[data-i="'+i+'"]');const dest=$('destinationLayer').querySelector('[data-dest="'+id+'"]');
 clue.classList.remove('selected');clue.style.transition='left .32s,top .32s,opacity .32s,transform .32s';clue.style.left=dest.style.left;clue.style.top=dest.style.top;clue.style.opacity='0';clue.style.transform='translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.4)';clue.style.pointerEvents='none';
 g.clues.push(i);g.found++;g.selectedClue=null;scene.classList.remove('placing');$('tr'+i).classList.add('done');$('tr'+i).classList.remove('selected');$('destinationLayer').querySelectorAll('.stash').forEach(el=>el.classList.remove('active'));
 reward(125,8);beep(700,.12);$('heading').textContent='Evidence hidden!';$('story').textContent=item.action;toast(item.action);checkCleanup();
}
function stopScrub(){scrub=null;$('mopAnim').classList.add('hidden')}
function stainDown(e,i,b){if(g.phase!=='cleanup'||g.paused||g.modal)return;e.preventDefault();const v=g.stains[i],item=dirt[i];if(v.done)return;
 if(item.tool==='mop'&&mode!=='mop'){toast('Muddy paw prints! Select 🧹 MOP, then swipe over them.');return}
 if(item.tool!=='mop'&&mode==='spray'){v.wet=true;b.classList.add('wet');reward(10,0);beep(520);toast('Sprayed '+item.name+'! Use WIPE and rub it away.');cleanupActions();return}
 if(item.tool!=='mop'&&mode!=='wipe'){toast('Select SPRAY, then WIPE the '+item.name+'!');return}
 if(item.tool!=='mop'&&!v.wet){toast('Spray this stain FIRST!');return}
 b.setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);scrub={i,x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY};v.progress=clamp(v.progress+3,0,100);b.style.setProperty('--scrub',v.progress);
 if(mode==='mop')moveMop(e);
}
function moveMop(e){let el=$('mopAnim'),rect=scene.getBoundingClientRect();el.style.left=(e.clientX-rect.left)+'px';el.style.top=(e.clientY-rect.top)+'px';el.classList.remove('hidden')}
function stainMove(e,i,b){if(!scrub||scrub.i!==i||g.phase!=='cleanup'||g.paused||g.modal)return;const v=g.stains[i];if(v.done)return;
 const len=Math.hypot(e.clientX-scrub.x,e.clientY-scrub.y);scrub.x=e.clientX;scrub.y=e.clientY;if(len<1)return;
 v.progress=clamp(v.progress+Math.min(len*0.48,20),0,100);b.style.setProperty('--scrub',v.progress);if(mode==='mop')moveMop(e);
 if(v.progress>=100){v.done=true;b.classList.add('done');if(dirt[i].tool==='mop')$('seatTracks').classList.add('clean');g.washed++;stopScrub();reward(145,8);beep(860,.12);toast((dirt[i].tool==='mop'?'FLOOR DE-RACCOONED!':'SPARKLING CLEAN!')+' '+g.washed+'/3 stains');checkCleanup()}
}
function cleanupActions(){scene.dataset.tool=mode;actions([['🔎 HINT',hint,'teal'],['🧴 SPRAY',()=>{mode='spray';cleanupActions();toast('Tap the wet or sticky mess to spray it.')},mode==='spray'?'selected magenta':'magenta'],['🧽 WIPE',()=>{mode='wipe';cleanupActions();toast('Rub your finger across a sprayed stain.')},mode==='wipe'?'selected magenta':'magenta'],['🧹 MOP',()=>{mode='mop';cleanupActions();toast('Swipe back and forth over the muddy raccoon paws!')},mode==='mop'?'selected magenta':'magenta']]);}
function hint(){if(g.phase!=='cleanup')return;
 if(g.selectedClue!==null){const item=items[g.selectedClue];toast('Hide '+item.short+' in '+destinations.find(d=>d.id===item.target).name+'.');return}
 const index=items.findIndex((_,i)=>!g.clues.includes(i));if(index>=0){const b=$('evidenceLayer').querySelector('[data-i="'+index+'"]');b?.classList.add('hinted');toast(items[index].hint+'!');setTimeout(()=>b?.classList.remove('hinted'),2600)}
 else if(g.washed<3){const i=g.stains.findIndex(v=>!v.done);toast(dirt[i].tool==='mop'?'MOP the muddy paw prints on the FLOOR!':'SPRAY + WIPE the '+dirt[i].name+'!')}
 else toast('Ready for Noosh!');
}
function cleanupTick(){if(g.phase!=='cleanup'||g.paused||g.modal)return;g.seconds=Math.max(0,g.seconds-.1);$('clock').textContent=Math.ceil(g.seconds);if(g.seconds<=0){clearInterval(tick);finishCleanup(true)}}
function checkCleanup(){hud();if(g.found===4&&g.washed===3){clearInterval(tick);setTimeout(()=>{if(g.phase==='cleanup')finishCleanup(false)},700)}}
function finishCleanup(timeout){if(g.phase!=='cleanup')return;clearInterval(tick);phase('cleanupResult');$('tiny').style.display='';$('partner').style.display='';g.timeOver=timeout;g.patience=clamp(35+g.found*5+g.washed*7+(timeout?-11:8),0,100);$('heading').textContent=timeout?'NOOSH IS BACK!':'THE ROOM IS SUSPICIOUSLY CLEAN';$('kicker').textContent='CLEANUP RESULTS';$('story').textContent=`${g.found}/4 evidence hidden · ${g.washed}/3 messes cleaned`+(g.secret?' · secret clue recovered':'')+'.';setPartner('Mo');$('speech').classList.remove('hidden');$('speechName').textContent='MO';$('speechLine').textContent=timeout?'Too late. Act like this was always the decor.':'Honestly? Even I almost believe this room is normal.';actions([['FACE NOOSH ▸',()=>{g.q=0;question()},'gold']]);hud()}
function question(){phase('question');g.timed=false;const data=questions[g.q];$('tiny').style.display='';$('partner').style.display='';setPartner('Noosh');$('heading').textContent='Noosh’s Interrogation';$('kicker').textContent='QUESTION '+(g.q+1)+' / 3 • NO TIME LIMIT';$('story').textContent=data.q;$('speechName').textContent='NOOSH';$('speechLine').textContent=data.q;$('speech').classList.remove('hidden');actions(data.choices.map(([label,pat,chaos,ene],index)=>[label,()=>answer(index),index===1?'magenta':'gold']))}
function answer(i){if(g.phase!=='question')return;const [label,pat,chaos,ene]=questions[g.q].choices[i];g.choices.push(i);g.patience=clamp(g.patience+pat,0,100);reward(chaos,5);hud();phase('answer');$('heading').textContent='THE OFFICIAL RESPONSE';$('kicker').textContent='NOOSH IS TAKING NOTES';$('story').textContent='Tiny: '+label;$('speechName').textContent='TINY';$('speechLine').textContent=label;$('speech').classList.remove('hidden');actions([[g.q===2?'FINAL QUESTION ▸':'NEXT QUESTION ▸',()=>{g.q++;if(g.q>=3)panicStart();else question()},'gold']])}
function panicStart(){phase('panic');g.timed=true;g.remainingMs=7400;g.panicDeadline=performance.now()+7400;setPartner('Noosh');$('heading').textContent='THE LAST QUESTION';$('kicker').textContent='SUDDEN PANIC • ANSWER QUICKLY';$('story').textContent='NOOSH: DID YOU LICK THE THRONE?!';$('speechName').textContent='NOOSH';$('speechLine').textContent='DID YOU LICK MY THRONE?!';$('speech').classList.remove('hidden');actions([['It was quality control!',()=>panicAnswer('quality'),'teal'],['The raccoon did it.',()=>panicAnswer('raccoon'),'magenta'],['Five times. Allegedly.',()=>panicAnswer('honest'),'gold']]);clearInterval(tick);tick=setInterval(()=>{if(g.phase!=='panic'||g.paused||g.modal)return;g.remainingMs=Math.max(0,g.panicDeadline-performance.now());$('kicker').textContent='ANSWER QUICKLY • '+(g.remainingMs/1000).toFixed(1)+'s';if(g.remainingMs===0)panicAnswer('timeout')},70)}
function panicAnswer(answer){if(g.phase!=='panic')return;clearInterval(tick);g.finalChoice=answer;if(answer==='quality'){g.patience+=9;reward(100,0)}else if(answer==='raccoon'){g.patience-=10;reward(180,0)}else if(answer==='honest'){g.patience+=3;reward(200,0)}else{g.patience-=14;reward(40,0)}g.patience=clamp(g.patience,0,100);hud();ending()}
function ending(){phase('end');let name,desc;const secret=g.secret&&g.found===4&&g.washed===3&&g.choices[0]===0&&g.choices[1]===0&&g.finalChoice==='quality'&&(window.__tinyStoryContext?.cluesFound?.length||0)>=2;if(secret){name='THE SECRET INCIDENT FILE';desc='Noosh discovers your perfect cover-up was actually a brilliant undercover inspection. The crown has never looked cleaner. Tiny has quietly stolen the official incident stamp.'}
else if(g.patience>=72&&g.found+g.washed>=5){name='ROYAL PARDON';desc='Noosh finds very little evidence and, against every instinct, officially grants Tiny a pardon.'}
else if(g.patience>=49){name='MANDATORY UTW TRAINING';desc='Tiny must attend a responsible decision-making seminar. Sea is somehow appointed instructor.'}
else if(g.chaos>=650){name='CROWNED MENACE';desc='The cover-up collapses, but Tiny is accidentally crowned Supreme Director of Unsupervised Activities.'}
else{name='SENT TO THE CORNER';desc='Noosh has had enough. Tiny is sentenced to the corner with a water bottle and absolutely no access to trains.'}
g.end=name;g.archive.endings??=[];g.archive.achievements??=[];if(!window.__tinyPractice&&!g.archive.endings.includes(name))g.archive.endings.push(name);if(g.found===4)achievement('Evidence Eraser');if(g.washed===3)achievement('Throne Detailer');if(g.secret)achievement('Secret Clue Hunter');if(name==='THE SECRET INCIDENT FILE')achievement('Master of the Cover-Up');storeArchive();$('tiny').style.display='';$('partner').style.display='';setPartner('Noosh');$('speech').classList.add('hidden');$('heading').textContent=name;$('kicker').textContent='STAGE 6 COMPLETE • '+g.chaos.toLocaleString()+' CHAOS';$('story').textContent=desc;actions([['VIEW COMPLETE INCIDENT REPORT ▸',()=>window.parent.postMessage({type:'TINY_STAGE_DONE',stage:6,score:g.chaos,energy:g.energy,meta:{found:g.found,washed:g.washed,secret:g.secret,patience:g.patience,choices:g.choices,finalChoice:g.finalChoice},ending:g.end},'*'),'gold'],['REPLAY STAGE 6 ↻',reset,'magenta'],['NOOSH’S ARCHIVES',archiveView,'teal']])}
function achievement(name){if(!g.archive.achievements.includes(name))g.archive.achievements.push(name)}
function archiveView(){if(window.parent!==window){window.parent.postMessage({type:'TINY_OPEN_ARCHIVE'},'*');return}g.paused=true;const el=$('archives');el.classList.remove('hidden');const names=['ROYAL PARDON','MANDATORY UTW TRAINING','CROWNED MENACE','SENT TO THE CORNER','THE SECRET INCIDENT FILE'];el.replaceChildren();const head=document.createElement('h2');head.textContent='📁 NOOSH’S INCIDENT ARCHIVES';el.appendChild(head);const p=document.createElement('p');p.textContent='Unlocked endings, achievements, and the secret clue board are saved when your browser permits.';el.appendChild(p);const grid=document.createElement('div');grid.className='grid';names.forEach((name,i)=>{const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='ending';d.textContent=g.archive.endings.includes(name)?'✅ '+name:'🔒 '+(i===4?'???':name);grid.appendChild(d)});el.appendChild(grid);const a=document.createElement('p');a.textContent='Achievements: '+(g.archive.achievements.join(' • ')||'None yet');el.appendChild(a);const b=document.createElement('p');b.textContent='Secret clue board: '+(g.archive.secrets||0)+' discoveries';el.appendChild(b);const close=document.createElement('button');close.textContent='BACK TO RESULTS';close.onclick=()=>{el.classList.add('hidden');g.paused=false};el.appendChild(close)}
$('secret').addEventListener('click',()=>{if(g.phase!=='cleanup'||g.paused||g.secret)return;g.secret=true;g.archive.secrets=(g.archive.secrets||0)+1;$('secret').classList.add('revealed');reward(180,10);toast('SECRET CLUE: the royal inspection seal!');storeArchive()});
function modalOpen(kind){if(g.modal)return;g.modal=true;g.paused=true;if(g.phase==='panic')g.remainingMs=Math.max(0,g.panicDeadline-performance.now());const el=$('modal');el.replaceChildren();el.classList.remove('hidden');const h=document.createElement('h2');h.textContent=kind==='help'?'HOW TO PLAY':'GAME PAUSED';el.appendChild(h);const p=document.createElement('p');p.textContent=kind==='help'?'Tap a clue, then tap the GLOWING real-world hiding spot: ticket to the wooden crate, cap to the wastebasket, sticker to the bookshelf, and warranty under the carpet. Select SPRAY then WIPE to scrub wet or sticky throne marks. Select MOP then swipe over the muddy raccoon prints on the floor. Answer Noosh’s questions; the last one is timed!':'Noosh is still counting to ten. The game is frozen until you resume.';el.appendChild(p);const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='btn';b.textContent=kind==='help'?'GOT IT ▸':'RESUME ▸';b.onclick=modalClose;el.appendChild(b)}
function modalClose(){if(!g.modal)return;$('modal').classList.add('hidden');g.modal=false;g.paused=false;if(g.phase==='panic')g.panicDeadline=performance.now()+g.remainingMs}
$('help').onclick=()=>{if(g.modal)modalClose();else modalOpen('help')};$('pause').onclick=()=>{if(g.modal)modalClose();else modalOpen('pause')};$('sound').onclick=()=>{sound=!sound;$('sound').textContent=sound?'♫':'♪̸'};$('full').onclick=()=>window.parent.postMessage({type:'TINY_TOGGLE_FULLSCREEN'},'*');
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'&&g.modal)modalClose();if(g.phase==='cleanup'&&!g.paused){if(e.key==='1')mode='find';if(e.key==='2'){mode='spray';cleanupActions()}if(e.key==='3'){mode='wipe';cleanupActions()}}});
reset();
})();
</script></body></html>
